cover.concept: Small rounded tiles in slightly mismatched shades of orange and uneven sizes drifting loosely on the left, passing through a single thin muted-indigo rectangular frame at center, and leaving on the right aligned in one calm, evenly spaced row, every tile now the exact same accent orange and the same size.

inline.name: five-styles-one-business
inline.concept: Five small rounded shapes scattered across a pale field, each a slightly different tint, size and corner radius, none quite matching the others; only one carries a crisp outline in the exact accent orange, quietly setting the standard the others miss.

inline.name: one-master-many-versions
inline.concept: One solid accent-orange rectangle at the center of a pale field, with three smaller muted-indigo outlined rectangles of different proportions (tall, square, wide) arranged around it, each repeating the same simple inner arrangement of one bar and one dot, like faithful echoes of the original.
